name: watchdog
description: Checks that running agents make real progress, not just activity: raises a stalled notice, then cancels an agent that stays stalled, on a timer.

stalledAfterMs.description: No checkpoint with changed files and no new tool kind for this long: the agent is stalled (a notice)

stopAfterMs.description: No progress for this long (counted from the last progress, like stalledAfterMs): the agent is cancelled with the reason
